body:
The model list comes from presets built into the binary (`src/default-models.toml`) plus `[[models]]` in the system configuration. When an agent program gains new models, for example a Claude Code update, Solace doesn't show them until it is rebuilt or the human edits the config. Solace should ask each agent which models it offers.

### Per agent (confirm current options before building)

- **Codex.** The app-server's `model/list` JSON-RPC call lists the models Codex can use, with their reasoning efforts. Use it for the list and for `efforts` in place of the fixed list in `board.rs::efforts`. Some entries are hidden: leave those out. A listed model isn't proof the account may use it; usage limits are handled in task:6354ec5642573754.
- **Claude Code.** As far as we know there is no non-interactive model list (only a feature request for `claude model list`). Fallbacks, in order:
  1. If the installed version has a list command, use it.
  2. Offer Claude Code's aliases (`opus`, `sonnet`, `haiku`), which it maps to the latest model of each family, so a Claude Code update brings new models without a Solace change. Show the model a run actually used, from its log's start event, in the run and in the label once known.
  3. With an `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` sign-in, the provider's models endpoint can list exact ids. Solace still stores no key; it only uses the variable that is already set.

### Behaviour

- Discovered models merge with the presets and config. The config still wins for the same id, and presets remain the fallback when discovery fails or the program is missing.
- Discovery runs at startup and then at most every few minutes (or on a `refresh` in the picker). It never blocks `/models`: it serves the last list and refreshes in the background.
- A model that disappears from discovery stays assignable to tasks already using it, but isn't offered for new ones.
- One discovery entry per agent kind, in the same per-agent table as availability (task:6354ec5642573754), so another harness only adds an entry.

### Checks

- Unit tests with recorded `model/list` output and Claude fallbacks: merge order, hidden entries left out, efforts taken from Codex, presets used when discovery fails.
- An acceptance test with the fake agents: a model the fake Codex reports appears in `/models` without a config change.
- Guide and README Models sections updated.
title: agents: discover each agent's models
